title: EyeTAG: Eye Trajectory-Aware Gaze Estimation
abstract: arXiv:2610.00922v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Gaze estimation under natural head-eye motion underpins applications from driver monitoring to human-computer interaction. Single-frame methods predict each frame independently, so consecutive outputs fluctuate as jitter. Multi-frame methods reduce this, but they learn motion implicitly inside appearance features, so the gaze trajectory is never an explicit variable. We propose EyeTAG (Eye Trajectory-Aware Gaze Estimation), a causal multi-frame framework built around an explicit first-order gaze prior: at each step it differentiates its own recent predictions and feeds the resulting trajectory back as a compact kinematic token. Because differencing is translation-invariant in gaze space, this token carries subject-invariant motion rather than personal gaze offsets. Face and eye streams supply visual evidence, fused by cross-attention and a causal Transformer decoder. EyeTAG reduces the mean angular error by about 1.0$^\circ$ on Gaze360

translated_title: EyeTAG：眼动轨迹感知的视线估计
translated_abstract: 自然头部-眼部运动下的视线估计是驾驶员监控、人机交互等诸多应用的基础。单帧方法独立预测每一帧，导致连续输出产生抖动；多帧方法虽能缓解这一问题，但它们在外观特征中隐式地学习运动，视线轨迹始终未被作为显式变量。我们提出EyeTAG（眼动轨迹感知视线估计），这是一个围绕显式一阶视线先验构建的因果多帧框架：在每一步，它对自身近期的预测进行差分，并将得到的轨迹作为一个紧凑的运动学token反馈回网络。由于差分在视线空间中具有平移不变性，该token所携带的是与主体无关的运动信息，而非个体视线偏移。人脸与眼部两个视觉流提供视觉证据，并通过交叉注意力和因果Transformer解码器进行融合。EyeTAG在Gaze360数据集上将平均角度误差降低了约1.0度。
tldr: EyeTAG提出了一种显式利用一阶视线轨迹先验的因果多帧视线估计框架，将近期预测差分得到的运动学token反馈回网络以实现主体无关的运动建模，在Gaze360上将平均角度误差降低约1.0度。
en_tdlr: EyeTAG is a causal multi-frame gaze estimation framework that explicitly feeds back a first-order gaze trajectory token—derived by differencing its recent predictions and thus subject-invariant—reducing the mean angular error by about 1.0° on Gaze360.
